messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate in embeddings-service (us-west-2). Error rate spike > 20% for the last 3m, latency elevated, customers seeing 500s. Auto-escalation to oncall.

alex: I'm on it. Investigating tail logs now. @sam can you confirm if we've had any config pushes in the last hour?

sam: no infra deploys. Seeing increased connection resets to the redis caching layer. Dumping netstat and connections.

maya: Support heads up — starting a draft customer notification for hosted api users and any dedicated customers in us-west-2. Will share list. @carla can you help with customer impact tiers?

carla: on it. Pulling last 24h usage for accounts with >1M tokens/day. Will mark critical & high.

alex: opening AWS escalation now. @liam can you DM the cloud APAC partner ops contact and request an expedited network check? Need to know if this is a provider-side networking flake.

liam: pinged partner ops (cc: partner-ops). Contacted AWS TAC: case number 1234567890 opened. Asking for instance-level NIC drops and ENI diagnostics. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/1234567890

sam: quick mitigation: force routing traffic to fallback redis cluster in us-east-1, will take ~90s to warm. Command:
```
kubectl set env deployment/embeddings SERVICE_REDIS=redis-fallback.us-east-1:6379
```

alex: performing canary failover, will monitor error rate and tail logs. If error rate drops below 1% we can roll forward.

incident-bot: Running automated health checks every 30s. Next check in 00:00:25.

10m later...

sam: failover completed, warming KV cache. Error rate dropped from 22% -> 1.4%. Latency stable. Keeping monitoring for 15m before fully cutting over.

maya: Draft customer message v1:
"We experienced an elevated error rate for embeddings in us-west-2 affecting some hosted and dedicated customers. We have routed requests to a fallback cluster and are monitoring. No data loss. ETA to full recovery: 30-60 minutes."

carla: Suggest adding 'affected customers will see a small increase in latency ~50-100ms' and link to status page. Also recommend targeted emails for the top 10 affected accounts.

alex: agreed. @maya please add latency note and publish to status page.

maya: Status page update template:
```
[Update - Under Investigation] 2025-10-18 14:32 UTC — We are investigating elevated errors for embeddings in us-west-2. We've routed traffic to a fallback cluster; impact remains for a subset of requests. Engineers are working with AWS on root cause. Next update in 30 minutes or when we have new info.
```

liam: AWS replied: NIC resets observed on a subset of instances; TAC recommends instance network re-provisioning and support team is coordinating with networking team. They've prioritized the case.

sam: re-provisioning in progress on 3 affected nodes. Rolling restart scheduled. Will update when nodes return.

alex: handing off to @sam for overnight monitoring. I'm wrapping up and will join on-call handover call in 5. Key notes in runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-incident

sam: acknowledged. I'll keep the channel updated and escalate back to @alex if error rate >5% or if AWS signals further network instability.

maya: customer notifications sent to affected list (email and in-app). Status page updated. cc: @carla for downstream CS threads.

carla: prepping post-incident outreach template. Will coordinate billing/credits if customers impacted >2h.

incident-bot: Incident marker: remediation actions in progress. Tickets: AWS 1234567890. On-call owner: sam. Severity: Sev2. Next routine check in 15m.

alex: thanks everyone — fantastic run. We'll do a follow-up postmortem and vendor comms recap once stabilized. :thumbsup:
